title: My Hero Academia’s Ending Is Way Better Than Fans Remember Thanks to One Crucial Detail
content: Written and illustrated by Kohei Horikoshi, My Hero Academia is one of the most popular Shonen anime and manga series. The manga reached its conclusion on August 5th, 2024, after 10 years of serialization, and the anime followed suit shortly afterward.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Years Later, Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Upcoming Movie Finally Gets a Major Update
content: Established in 2011, animation studio MAPPA took only a few years to become one of the biggest in the industry. The studio is best known for creating famous shows such as Jujutsu Kaisen , Chainsaw Man, Attack on Titan (from Season 4), and many more acclaimed series.
author: ComicBook

title: Comic Market 108 Draws 260,000 Attendees Across 2 Days
content: Comiket 108 had about 23,000 regular exhibiting spaces over the two days — a slight decrease of 700 spaces from Comiket 107. A record-breaking 121 companies exhibited in the corporate area. Comiket 107 drew about 300,000 people across two days from December 30 through December 31.
author: ANN

title: Netflix Is Losing Attack on Titan Studio’s Darkest Fantasy in September
content: 2026 has been an exciting year for anime fans with the premiere of several exciting shows on Netflix, such as Love Through a Prism, Cosmic Princess Kaguya , Dandelion , and more. However, while the platform keeps bringing new series for fans, it’s also quietly removing some beloved series as well.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s New Naruto Replacement Is Delivering What Took Naruto Hundreds of Episodes to Build Up
content: Crunchyroll ‘s hottest new shonen anime of 2026, Black Torch , which has emerged as a sort of replacement for Naruto , is set to feature an intriguing fight that took Naruto hundreds of episodes to deliver.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Tensei shitara Ken deshita II' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website of the television anime adaptation of Yuu Tanaka 's Tensei shitara Ken deshita ( Reincarnated as a Sword ) light novel revealed an additional pair of cast, a key visual (pictured), theme songs, and the second promotional video for its second season on Sunday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Shogakukan Announces Findings from 3rd-Party Investigation, Measures Company Will Take to Prevent Recurrence After Shōichi Yamamoto Scandal
content: Shogakukan revealed on August 3 a summary of findings following the third-party investigation into the publisher's Manga ONE editorial department and involvement with manga creator Shōichi Yamamoto . On August 4, the company then released a list of measures that it plans to enact in response to the findings.
author: ANN

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Begins Streaming Third Opening Song "Song of Light" by Yuiko Ohara
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed a new opening song following the premiere of Episode 8 on August 16. The episode began the Chaos Breaker arc , which recently revealed a trailer. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
author: Anime Corner

title: Witch Hat Atelier Wins Astra Award for Best Anime
content: Tthe film critics in the Hollywood Creative Alliance (formerly the Hollywood Critics Association) gave the television anime of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga the award for Best Anime Series at the 2026 Astra TV Awards on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Anime Unleashes Its Hero’s Terrifying New Transformation, But It’s Surprisingly Cute
content: The Summer of 2026 is also featuring a brand-new shonen anime, which is currently airing on Crunchyroll . The series has rapidly progressed and is already featuring the classic shonen hero transformation that other series take much longer to introduce.
author: ComicBook
